## Sunshower (G4)

Sunshower is the pale-yellow Pegasus on Cloudsdale's weather crew whose confusion over coworkers **Open Skies** and **Clear Skies** lets Rainbow Dash quietly swipe the winter clouds in *Friendship Is Magic*, “Tanks for the Memories” (S5E5). She has a blue, lighter-streaked mane and tail, blue eyes, and a rain-themed cutie mark. She is the **yellow pony at left** in the still below.

[![Sunshower (left), Clear Skies, and Open Skies — *Tanks for the Memories* screencap](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/2/18/2312082/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2312082)

*Image: episode still; animation by DHX Media / Hasbro Studios. The linked Twibooru post provides the source and image metadata.*

**Name and voice.** “Sunshower” is a licensed name, used in the [Gameloft mobile game](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Sunshower) and the Enterplay card game; the episode does not say her name aloud. She **speaks** in S5E5, voiced in English by **Cathy Weseluck** ([episode cast listing](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4486712/fullcredits/)). The [Weather Control Pegasi reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Weather_Control_Pegasi) also records an appearance in IDW's *My Little Pony: Deviations*, an alternate-history comic; that is a separate continuity. Do not confuse her with the [G4 background mare Sunshower Raindrops](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sunshower_Raindrops) or the unrelated purple G3 pony also called Sunshower.

## Important moments

Both scenes are in [“Tanks for the Memories” (S5E5), full-episode upload](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RCoGgwErNQY). **Timestamps unavailable:** the upload's scene alignment could not be independently verified.

1. **Who's on first—with clouds?** — *Tanks for the Memories*, S5E5. Sunshower tries to find where to move the snow clouds, but Open Skies and Clear Skies turn the directions into a comic misunderstanding while Rainbow Dash removes clouds unnoticed.
2. **Another shipment arrives.** — *Tanks for the Memories*, S5E5. She calls for the next load of clouds to be moved into position, showing the weather crew continuing its winter preparations despite Rainbow Dash's efforts; this drives Dash to target the Cloudsdale weather factory.

The [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Tanks_for_the_Memories) documents both spoken scenes.
